model.name: Poolside Laguna S 2.1
model.quant: Q4_K_M with resident planar-qmicro Q6_K selected down

implementation.scope: Q6 planar-qmicro selected down; one D4 activation plane; 64 output columns x 64 routed rows; local128
implementation.mapping: four wave32 groups own independent 16-row bands and each issue two signed-int8 x unsigned-Q6 16x16x16 WMMA fragments per K32
implementation.arithmetic: the two K16 integer results retain the existing per-half Q6 scale, -32*sum(x) correction, ordered FP32 K32 accumulation, and BF16 store
implementation.runtime_policy: unspecified integer_wmma selects the new body only for the already-constrained gfx1151 planar-qmicro row64 path; integer_wmma=false preserves the leaf A/B baseline

correctness.red: The production-shape uneven/empty-expert case failed because the integer_wmma wrapper selector did not exist.
correctness.focused_gate: 12 Q6 geometry/quality cases plus two Laguna MoE runtime cases pass; the candidate is BF16-byte identical to the retained planar body and passes KL <= 0.05, top-1 >= 90%, and relative-L2 <= 5e-3.
correctness.focused_command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -m pytest -q 'tests/test_gguf_q4_k_q8_1_selected_prefill.py::test_q6_k_t16_ds4x3_f32_mmq64x32_matches_cpu_quality_gate' tests/test_laguna_moe_gpu.py::test_laguna_model_moe_plan_resolves_production_contract_on_gfx1151 tests/test_laguna_moe_gpu.py::test_laguna_mmq_selected_down_reuses_exact_grouped_combine
correctness.lifecycle_command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_laguna_gguf_runner.py::test_laguna_owned_session_close_frees_weights_and_is_idempotent

actual_weight_layer1_leaf.timing: HIP events; activation packing excluded; 21 counter-rotated burst-seven pairs

trace.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-format csv --output-directory <tmp> --output-file q6-int-wmma-leaf -- env HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_q6_qmicro_leaf.py --samples 1 --warmups 0 --prefill-burst 1 --decode-burst 1 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --output /tmp/laguna-q6-int-wmma-trace-child.json
